questions.stem: A 22yr old primigravida with 10 months of gestation presents to the OPD as she hasn’t had labour. She doesn’t remember her LMP. She has not visited for any ANC, first and second-trimester usg, nor had any prior lab investigations. She has no comorbidities. On examination, P-80/min, BP-120/86mmHg, RR-13/min, afebrile, saturation normal, pallor+. Abdominal examination shows fundus below xiphisternum, vertical lie, cephalic presentation, head engaged, FHR-140/min. PV examination shows cervix uneffaced, not dilated, admits tip of the finger, membranes intact. Fetal NST was normal. She was sent for usg after sending samples for routine laboratory investigations. Usg showed oligohydramnios and post-dated pregnancy. The complications associated with this condition during labor are:Shoulder dystociaCord compressionFetal hypoxia and alkalosisHypoglycaemia and polycythaemiaIncreased incidence of operative deliverySelect the correct answer from the given below code:
